key_findings: Electroacupuncture reduced cartilage damage, MMP13, synovitis, synovial apoptosis and IL-1β/TNF-α while raising IL-10/TGF-β1 in rat ACLT knee osteoarthritis.
EA was associated with restored synovial Protein S-Axl/MerTK-Rac1 expression, stronger at mRNA than protein level; mechanism is provisional.
